inclusion_rule: All 8 NASA-listed physical planets; all 5 NASA/IAU-recognized dwarf planets; JPL discovery-table natural satellites with both permanent IAU name and number plus a unique JPL Horizons major-body ID; Earth Moon and named Eris/Haumea dwarf satellites from JPL major-body identities; existing LOOM-registered asteroids and reference bodies. Provisional-only satellites and unrelated small bodies are excluded.

sources.name: Planetary Satellite Discovery Circumstances
sources.role: IAU-recognized permanent names and designations for planetary satellites and Pluto satellites
sources.limitations: Exact response is retained as gzip; parser HTML has trailing padding removed. The table explicitly excludes Earth's Moon and satellites of dwarf planets other than Pluto; provisional-only rows are filtered out.

sources.name: Horizons major-body list (COMMAND=MB)
sources.role: Stable Horizons/NAIF identities for planets, named moons, Sun and dwarf-system physical bodies
sources.limitations: Exact response is retained as gzip; parser text has trailing fixed-width padding removed. ID presence does not guarantee ephemeris coverage at 2226 or navigation grade. Generic MB membership does not itself qualify an object for the experiment.

sources.name: About the Planets
sources.role: Eight physical planets and five IAU-recognized dwarf planets; terrestrial/giant distinction
sources.limitations: Classification page, not a state-vector or physical-property authority; raw HTML not retained because the normalized 8/5 identity lists and source URL suffice for the bounded freeze.
